title: NOVA-201 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma
subtitle: Advisory board — scientific questions for discussion · SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
approval_status: NOVANTERA (novantamab) is approved in the US for adults with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after ≥4 prior lines of therapy. All other uses discussed are investigational. ALL DATA IN THIS DECK ARE SYNTHETIC — this is a design exemplar, not a clinical document.

slides.title: What remains unknown
bullets: No randomised comparison against current standard of care — every efficacy statement in this deck is single-arm
No prospective data on sequencing after prior BCMA-directed therapy
Median follow-up 16.9 months; DOR and OS are immature
Trial excluded ECOG ≥2 (except n=19), CrCl <40, and prior CAR-T within 90 days — the patients clinicians ask about most
